about: Golden bodies of the private packs' routes (Protocol E11, GitHub #13250): what coax/web/api/verse_packs.c answers on POST /api/verse/packs/<name> (the same route as POST /api/metaverse/packs/<name>) and its refusals, with the status each came with. Every body was answered by a running API in coax/web/api/test.sh (tests/verse_packs.coax with VERSE_PACK_CAPTURE=1, on a build host, 2026-11-12), at the commit before the codec, on a throwaway database with a made-up pack; the keys are that run's session keys, under a master key the run made up. coax/web/api/packs-wire-goldens.coax holds each body's keys to its message (proto/openagents/verse/packs/v1alpha1/packs.proto PackSession, or the API's ErrorReply), reads it through coax/lib/media/pack_session_wire.coax and writes it back for the same bytes; tests/verse_packs.coax does the same for every answer of every run.
